Franklin Lacey | Franklin Lacey (1917–1988) was an American playwright and screenwriter.  He is best known for co-authoring the story for "The Music Man" (1957), together with collaborator Meredith Willson, and later collaborating on the screenplay with Marion Hargrove for the 1962 film version.
